<thought>I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that, in the forward direction, forms a cycloaddition product while breaking a carbonyl (ketone/ester) and a C‑C triple bond. In the retrosynthetic direction this corresponds to breaking a C‑O bond (the carbonyl) and a C‑C triple bond, and generating a ketone (or ester) and an alkyne as the two precursors. The valid functional‑group names are “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O", "C#C"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
